description: Node hierarchy of the edited scene: name, class, relative path, attached script and instanced scene for each node.

depth.description: Max depth below the subtree root (default 10).

path.description: Subtree root. Node path relative to the edited scene's root; '.' is the root itself (e.g. 'Player/Sprite2D'). Default '.'.
